claims.gist: AI vulnerability tools are extremely effective at finding open-source vulnerabilities
Frontier-lab scanners are overhyped while AI SAST as a whole is underhyped
Maintainers get more pull requests and issues than ever from AI submissions
Latest AI vulnerability-detection models are gated to large enterprises
NVD is at its lowest point in enriching data; Flashpoint and VulnCheck pick up the slack
Vulnerability management is going private, for better and for worse
Delaying public disclosure relies on security through obscurity
Private pressures will likely leave the CVE ecosystem going out with a whisper

thesis: AI vulnerability discovery is going private, weakening public disclosure, enrichment and the CVE ecosystem.
